description: This file defines the TableRenderer class responsible for rendering tables within the MigraDoc document generation library. It includes methods for layout calculation, rendering headers, cells, borders, shading, and managing table structure such as connected rows/columns and border maps.

classes.name: TableRenderer
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering a table object onto a graphics context, handling layout, borders, shading, and cell content.

methods.name: InitialLayoutInfo
methods.description: Provides initial layout information for the table rendering, including margins and keep properties.

methods.name: InitRendering
methods.description: Initializes rendering state, including border maps, connected rows/columns, and formatted cells.

methods.name: RenderHeaderRows
methods.description: Renders the header rows of the table based on header formatting.

methods.name: RenderCell
methods.description: Renders an individual cell, including shading, content, and borders.

methods.name: EqualizeRoundedCornerBorders
methods.description: Ensures consistent border widths for cells with rounded corners.

methods.name: RenderShading
methods.description: Renders cell shading.

methods.name: RenderBorders
methods.description: Renders cell borders, including handling rounded corners and diagonal borders.

methods.name: RenderDiagonalBorders
methods.description: Renders diagonal borders within a cell.

methods.name: RenderContent
methods.description: Renders the content inside a cell, aligned vertically.

methods.name: GetInnerRect
methods.description: Calculates the inner rectangle area for a cell, considering borders and merge spans.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Main rendering method that initializes and renders the table.

methods.name: InitFormat
methods.description: Initializes formatting information for the table, including connected rows/columns and header detection.

methods.name: FormatCells
methods.description: Measures and formats all cells in the table.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Calculates the layout of the table within a given area, considering page breaks and height constraints.

methods.name: UpdateThisPagesBookmarks
methods.description: Updates bookmarks for the current page's rows.

methods.name: FinishLayoutInfo
methods.description: Finalizes layout info after rendering, setting content area and alignment.

methods.name: LeftBorderOffset
methods.description: Calculates the left border offset for the table.

methods.name: CalcStartingHeight
methods.description: Calculates the starting height for rendering, based on header rows or top borders.

methods.name: CalcLastHeaderColumn
methods.description: Determines the last header column based on HeadingFormat property.

methods.name: CalcLastHeaderRow
methods.description: Determines the last header row based on HeadingFormat property.

methods.name: CreateConnectedRows
methods.description: Builds a map of connected rows considering MergeDown properties.

methods.name: CreateConnectedColumns
methods.description: Builds a map of connected columns considering MergeRight properties.

methods.name: CreateBottomBorderMap
methods.description: Creates a map of bottom border positions for table rows.

methods.name: CalcMaxTopBorderWidth
methods.description: Calculates the maximum top border width for a given row.

methods.name: CreateNextBottomBorderPosition
methods.description: Calculates the next bottom border position for the table.

methods.name: CalcBottomBorderWidth
methods.description: Calculates the bottom border width of a specific cell.

methods.name: GetMinMergedCell
methods.description: Finds the first cell ending in a specific row, considering MergeDown.

methods.name: CalcLastConnectedRow
methods.description: Returns cached last connected row for a given row.

methods.name: CalcLastConnectedRowDirect
methods.description: Calculates the last connected row without using cache.

methods.name: CalcLastConnectedColumn
methods.description: Calculates the last connected column considering MergeRight.
